name: Quest World on Quest cases
purpose: One balanced number over Quest cases for the composition of the World members (Model Plumbing, Science and Tools), run on Quest-only cases.
record: The balanced score of the composition on the same Quest cases, one row per run pinned to the commit and the cases hash.
disadvantages: It scores nothing until the Quest case source is wired and the hub's metric is named in a builds_on table with its component.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the composition runs the whole Quest case set with no model call] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real Quest case runs end to end through the World members and is hand-read]
